name: Toyoyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toyoyama town emblem in navy: a stylised bird-like device of angular strokes with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Toyoyama, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 October 1975.

features.role: Toyoyama town emblem — a stylised bird-like device of angular strokes with a disc
